claims.answer: Electron desktop app for macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux x64 (zip, deb) plus the ouijit CLI inside its terminals. No Windows, mobile, browser or editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: macOS 13+ (arm64, x64) and Linux x64; the FAQ and Getting started requirements list only these, so Windows is not offered.

task_actions.answer: Start, steer (type in the terminal), review diffs with notes, move status, resume and trash tasks in the app.

notifications.answer: Sound and OS notification when an agent turn ends; blue unseen dots and a queue count.

limitations: Windows, iOS, Android and browser clients do not exist; Ouijit does not run remotely.

evidence.title: Ouijit README
evidence.locator: Intro; Tasks and worktrees; Working with agents; Sandboxing; Setup; Supported harnesses
evidence.finding: Task and terminal manager for parallel coding agents: kanban board, one git worktree per task (copy-on-write), lifecycle hooks, session-aware ouijit CLI, diff review with notes, GitHub PR inbox and GitHub/Linear issues list (experimental), lenses, nono sandbox, session resume, local REST API and SQLite; macOS 13+ and Linux x64; AGPL-3.0, no account, no telemetry.

evidence.title: Ouijit FAQ
evidence.locator: faqs array (OS support, free, agents, isolation, sandbox)

evidence.title: Docs: Getting started
evidence.finding: Requires macOS 13+ or Linux x64, git 2.20+ and an agent CLI (claude, codex, pi or opencode); Linux deb and zip.

evidence.finding: Four statuses (To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done), per-task branch and worktree under ~/Ouijit/worktrees, merge targets for chaining, Quick start (CoW clone of ignored files) or Clean checkout modes, trash deletes branch and moves worktree to trash.

evidence.title: Docs: Hooks
evidence.finding: Start, continue, review and done hooks run on status changes with OUIJIT_TASK_* environment; run command and editor commands run on demand.

evidence.title: Docs: For agents
evidence.locator: What an agent receives; Drive the board; Review without posting; Inside a sandbox
evidence.finding: Supported harnesses get the ouijit CLI reference in their system prompt; agents resolve and move their own task; hooks asked of the user wait in a queue; PR and Linear comments are staged locally as drafts; per-session API token.

evidence.title: Docs: CLI
evidence.locator: Tasks; Hooks; Terminals; Diff notes; Your queue; Pull requests; Issues; Environment variables
evidence.finding: ouijit CLI talks to a localhost API with a per-session token and prints JSON; commands for tasks, hooks, terminals, diff notes, links, queue asks, tags, scripts, PR drafts, issues, panels, themes and projects.
